@snow_rooftop.name: snowing rooftop
@snow_rooftop.note: The open-air roof deck of a tall building, outdoors under open sky, with a clawfoot bathtub standing in the middle of it. Nothing overhead — no ceiling, no canopy, no pergola, no glass roof: falling snow lands on every surface because the sky is directly above. Flat roof, snow lying deep and undisturbed underfoot, a low parapet at the edge and the city dropping away beyond it to a far horizon. Steam holds its shape in the still cold air. A cool #2E4E7E cast on the snow.

Luxury
is…

Luxury is being warm
somewhere you've
no business
being warm.

Luxury is a detail
you're fairly sure
you weren't meant to notice.

Luxury is
a table laid for twelve,
and no intention of filling it.

Luxury is playing your whole heart out
to absolutely no one.

Luxury is standing in front of everything you own,
and wanting none of it.

For you to define.
